prompt:
2girls, artist:gray domain, manga, monochrome, high complexity, text, chinese text, very aesthetic, amazing quality. A single portrait manga page with five main panels and one bordered inset, six panels in total. A shallow wide establishing panel spans the top. In the middle band, a narrow tall panel on the left spans the combined height of two smaller horizontal panels stacked on the right. One large wide closing panel spans the bottom. A separate small rectangular detail panel is inset into the upper-left corner of the closing panel. This inset has a thick black rectangular panel border around a white background, with a narrow white gutter separating it from the surrounding closing-panel artwork. Inside that framed inset is a cropped close-up of the smartphone gallery screen filled with small selfie thumbnails. The inset leaves the closing speaker's face and speech bubble unobstructed on the right. Read the top panel first, then the tall middle-left panel, the upper middle-right panel, the lower middle-right panel, the phone inset, and finally the large closing panel. Use clearly visible gutters between main panels; the inset is the only intentional overlap. Panel identifiers are planning labels and are not printed in the artwork. The scene is a cozy band rehearsal room. The same Chihaya Anon appears in the top panel and both small middle-right panels; the same Nagasaki Soyo appears in the tall middle-left panel and the large closing panel. The inset shows Anon's smartphone gallery, not a new person. Their clothes and appearances remain consistent. A guitar on a stand, an amplifier, and acoustic wall panels establish the continuous setting. Expressive faces and subtle comedic timing. Leave generous white space in speech bubbles for clear horizontal Chinese lettering.
